source.title: A competitor grabbed a microphone during an attempt, to prevent it from falling
source.content:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the [regulation 2i](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2i) has been updated to provide more insight on what is permitted and not permitted regarding electronic usage.


A competitor was carrying a handheld microphone which was used for announcements during the competition. During a solve he had it lying on the table where it started to roll. He grabbed the microphone to make sure it did not fall off the table. Regulation 2i states:

> 2i) While inspecting or solving, competitors must not use electronics or audio equipment (e.g. cell phones, MP3 players, dictaphones, additional lighting) apart from the Stackmat timer or stopwatch. Penalty: disqualification of the attempt (DNF).

Given that the competitor was not **using** the microphone, he did not break this regulation. The solve was therefore ruled as OK.

translation.title: 选手在还原中抓住话筒以防掉落
translation.content:
说明：此事件处理后，[2i](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2i) 已更新，更清楚地说明电子设备使用的允许与禁止范围。

一名选手携带了比赛播报用的手持话筒。还原时话筒放在桌上并开始滚动，他抓住话筒以免掉下桌。2i 规定：
> 观察或还原时，不得使用 Stackmat 计时器或秒表以外的电子或音频设备，例如手机、MP3 播放器、录音机、额外照明；处罚为 DNF。

由于选手没有在**使用**话筒，因此未违反该规则，成绩被判定有效。
